title: Anthropic Provider: Test Harness
description:
Implement the full Anthropic provider test harness.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Plan: docs/plans/02-provider-anthropic-test-harness.md (all sections)

Key deliverables:
- Property tests P1-P4 (stream ordering, tool JSON delta convergence, usage/cost, error classification)
- Stub server tests S1 + fault injection F1-F5 (TCP reset, malformed SSE, throttling, backpressure, cancellation)
- Oracle tests O1-O2 (cross-implementation vs TS, SDK consistency)
- Deterministic simulations S1-S3 (event FSM, multi-tool, thinking+tool interleaving)
- Benchmarks B1-B4 (SSE >=50K/s, <=3 allocs/delta, tool JSON <100us, stream <5ms p95)
- Stress/soak ST1-ST3 (8hr soak, 500 concurrent, burst tool-call)
- Security SEC1-SEC3 (injection, header leakage, oversized payload)
- CI tier matrix wired

Depends on: Shared Test Infrastructure (aiag-jj7.1), Anthropic Core (aiag-jj7.2)
